candidates.sentence: On Capitol Hill, she will fight to ban assault weapons, expand background checks, and crack down on illegal firearms in our communities.
On Capitol Hill, she will fight to protect the Affordable Care Act from right-wing attacks and to expand coverage to the nearly 30 million Americans without health insurance.
She will also work to expand cancer screenings for first responders, guarantee that Medicare can negotiate drug prices for our Seniors, and reduce costs for millions of Americans.
Sarah is proud to support Amendment 1 – The Right to Reproductive Freedom Amendment in Maryland.
Congressman Sarbanes fought to protect voting rights, election integrity and security, campaign finance, and ethics in government.
